release_basis: SECURITY-R1 / AMENDMENT-2 final closure (Commander HOLD-1): shared host npm-cache mount REMOVED. Install uses NPM_CONFIG_CACHE=/tmp/npm-cache (tmpfs). Only the current run dir is host-mounted (/work RW in phase A, RO in phase C). Native sandbox RETIRED. Docker REQUIRED, no fallback. A proof pack can never vouch for its own verifier.
third_party_verification_order: 1. obtain this VERIFIER-RELEASE.json from the repository/release you trust
2. shasum -a 256 <pack>/verify.mjs and compare against verifier_sha256 here
3. also compare proof-manifest.json verifier_sha256 against verifier_sha256 here
4. docker pull <runtime_image> (exact digest; replay runs with --pull=never)
5. only then run: node verify.mjs (it prints VERIFIER_SHA256 as a convenience, never as proof)
